source_backbone: Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew POWO/WCVP 2026, IPNI original-name records, World Flora Online/Flora Novae Angliae for identity guardrails
synonym_and_rank_caution: The accepted name was validly published in 1907; the 1904 Link ex Vignolo usage is nom. inval. pro syn. POWO synonymizes several historical infraspecific taxa and E. multiglandulosa. IPNI's separate Biv. ex Steud. Poa cilianensis cross-link remains unresolved and must not be auto-normalized.
native_range_audit: DEFERRED — NOT REVIEWED; no county/native fields changed
photo_and_specimen_identity: HOLD — source-labelled individual specimens/photos not independently voucher-confirmed
hybrid_provenance: HOLD — no individual hybrid or cultivar ancestry inferred
install_decision: Retain existing canonical stinkgrass card; preserve aliases and author-qualified nomenclature in research evidence only. No card, media, genus, county, installation or Pages writes.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis cilianensis (All.) Vignolo ex Janch. (1907)
decisions.proposed_decision: Retain accepted species, authority and Poaceae/Eragrostis placement; canonical file unchanged
decisions.detail: Kew WCVP/POWO accepted at species rank; 1907 publication.

decisions.subject: Poa cilianensis All. (1785)
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve homotypic basionym as historical searchable alias; not a separate Poa species
decisions.detail: POWO and IPNI identify Allioni's 1785 Poa name as the original basionym.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis cilianensis (All.) Vignolo ex Janch. 1907 nomenclatural citation
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve Janchen's 1907 validation and correct author string
decisions.detail: IPNI and POWO agree on accepted author and 1907 place of publication.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis cilianensis (All.) Link ex Vignolo (1904)
decisions.proposed_decision: Record the 1904 combination as invalidly published, not the accepted name
decisions.detail: IPNI explicitly marks nom. inval. pro syn. and explains Vignolo rejected the combination.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis megastachya (Koeler) Link (1827)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical combination to accepted E. cilianensis
decisions.detail: Listed as a heterotypic synonym, not an independent accepted species.

decisions.subject: Poa megastachya Koeler (1802)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map to accepted E. cilianensis; preserve full authorship
decisions.detail: POWO accepts synonym destination E. cilianensis.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis major Host (1809)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map to accepted E. cilianensis with illegitimate/superfluous-name qualifier
decisions.detail: POWO lists E. major Host as nom. illeg. superfl.

decisions.subject: Briza eragrostis L. (1753)
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve historical heterotypic synonym under E. cilianensis
decisions.detail: Listed in POWO synonymy; do not infer homotypy.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis cilianensis subsp. starosselskyi (Grossh.) Tzvelev (1976)
decisions.proposed_decision: Treat historical subspecies as synonym of species-level E. cilianensis
decisions.detail: POWO explicitly gives E. cilianensis as accepted destination.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis cilianensis subsp. thyrsiflora (Willk.) H.Scholz & Valdés (2006)
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve as historical infraspecific synonym, not a separately accepted subspecies
decisions.detail: POWO places combination in heterotypic synonym list.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis cilianensis var. thyrsiflora (Willk.) Dobignard & Portal (2002)
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve historical variety as synonym of E. cilianensis
decisions.detail: POWO does not accept this variety separately.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis cilianensis subsp. major (Beck) Maire & Weiller (1953)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical subspecies to accepted E. cilianensis
decisions.detail: Infraspecific combination listed in POWO synonymy.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis multiglandulosa H.Scholz (2011)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map later published name to accepted E. cilianensis; preserve original name for search
decisions.detail: POWO follows World Grass Species Updates in synonymizing this name.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis eragrostis (L.) MacMill. (1892)
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve as not-validly-published historical synonym designation
decisions.detail: POWO marks not validly published.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis megastachya var. cilianensis (All.) Asch. & Graebn. (1900)
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve homotypic synonym with superfluous-name qualifier
decisions.detail: POWO marks nom. superfl.; IPNI links combination to Allioni's basionym.

decisions.subject: Automatically use the 1904 Vignolo/Link ex Vignolo combination as the accepted scientific authority
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject; keep the validly published 1907 Vignolo ex Janch. accepted citation
decisions.detail: The 1904 name is invalidly published pro synonymo.

decisions.subject: Promote historical E. cilianensis varieties/subspecies into distinct learner species without current acceptance
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject automatic split or duplicate card creation
decisions.detail: POWO currently accepts the species and lists reviewed infraspecific combinations in synonymy.

decisions.subject: Exact taxon identity of individual source-labelled Eragrostis cilianensis gallery photographs
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve specimen/photo identity uncertainty; do not certify images by nomenclature alone
decisions.detail: Taxonomy-only run did not inspect specimen vouchers or diagnostic photograph pixels.

decisions.subject: Hybrid, introgressed or cultivated ancestry of individual stinkgrass observations
decisions.proposed_decision: Do not infer hybrid or cultivar ancestry absent specimen/genetic/breeding evidence
decisions.detail: No specimen-level parentage evidence evaluated; no hybrid status assigned.

decisions.subject: IPNI Poa cilianensis Biv. ex Steud. (1854) cross-link versus Poa cilianensis All. (1785)
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve author-qualified records separately and request original-publication review before using Biv. ex Steud. as a basionym or alias
decisions.detail: IPNI presents a separate Biv. ex Steud. record linked as basionym of the accepted combination, while the accepted authorship is based on Allioni; nomenclatural interpretation requires original literature review.
